description: Ministry of Justice and National Integration - The Judicature Act, No 02 of 1978 Amendment to Justices of the Peace (Appointment, Suspension, Cancellation and code of Conduct) Regulations No. 3 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to regulations under the Judicature Act, specifically modifying the Justices of the Peace (Appointment, Suspension, Cancellation and Code of Conduct) Regulations. It deals with legal/regulatory matters including qualification criteria, appointment procedures, and conduct rules for judicial officers, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
